services.name: Meetings & Private Events
services.desc: Just a short drive from Atlanta yet far enough removed to provide peace and focus, Reid Barn offers an ideal retreat for corporate groups seeking more than a typical meeting room. Here, your team can escape the distractions of the office and immerse themselves in fresh surroundings - surrounded by nature, open spaces, and the quiet charm of the countryside. Whether you’re planning a day-long strategy retreat, offsite brainstorming session, or multi-day planning workshop, our flexible indoor and outdoor settings encourage creativity, connection, and renewal.
